attribution.title: Sint Nicolaas Basilica
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free low-poly reconstruction of Bleijs’s1884–1887 SintNicolaas basilica. Native geometry retains the actual52.45×22.87m church plan, thirteen measured in-parent OSM building parts, staggered twin6m west towers,13m octagonal crossing drum and stepped aisle/nave/transept/apse roofs. The parish documents58m dome height; modeled58m cross and56m tower crowns extend above AHN5 bulkroofmax50.889m, which does not capture fine lantern crosses. Ornament/curved metal crowns/rose window/arcaded entrance and clerestory are original simplified geometry from primary parish and architecture photographer references, with no imported source meshes/textures. Five adjacent rectory/side-annex parts outside the exact church parent and ordinary neighbors remain unsuppressed. Same-part proceduralSintNicolaas kit is replaced by this model; currentBAG1875 date is not treated as architectural evidence.
